description: Trigger processor: one trigger in produces a run of up to 32 triggers, spread across a window set by a tapped tempo

params.text: Switches between one burst per trigger and a burst that restarts itself as soon as the last one ends
Sets how many triggers a burst contains, 1 to 32
Starts a burst by hand, one per press
Attenuates the quantity CV, from nothing through to its full effect
Skews the spacing within the burst: even at noon, crowded at the start and slowing down clockwise, spread at the start and speeding up counter-clockwise
Multiplies or divides the tapped tempo to set the length of the burst window, by 2, 3, 4 or 5 either way, with the tempo itself at noon
Sets the chance that a trigger fires the whole burst rather than a single trigger, 100% counter-clockwise falling to 0% clockwise

inputs.text: Adds to the number of triggers in a burst, 5V adding sixteen, after the quantity attenuator
Skews the spacing within the burst, 10V covering the whole range, and is added to the distribution knob
Each pulse here sets the base tempo from the gap since the last one; a gap more than twice or less than half the one before it is discarded
Shifts the multiplication or division of the tempo, 10V covering four steps, and is added to the TIME DIV/MULT knob
Lowers the chance that a trigger fires the whole burst, 10V covering the whole range, and is added to the probability knob
A rising edge starts a burst

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V pulse at the base tempo, which runs at 2Hz until a ping sets it
A 1ms 10V pulse when a burst finishes; a burst cut short by the probability setting produces none
A 1ms 10V trigger for each event in the burst

menu: Include original trigger in output — sends the trigger that started the burst out as the burst's first trigger; on by default

inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
